name: Kanna
source:
A robot-like boy that analyzes, categorizes, and evaluates both people and objects. He doesn't have a large range of emotions and tries to get by through the most basic, simplistic form of communication. He is a member of NEW DIMENSION's Special for Princess!. As long as he is given an environment where his personal safety is ensured, he has no intention of making any special effort and believes that focusing only on what is necessary is fine.

[Translated from [url=https://ensemble-stars.jp/characters/kanna/]official website[/url]]
